# Player is at rows 18-23, horizontal path at rows 20-21
# Blocks are at rows 13-16
# Need to move UP more to align

seg = current_frame.segmentation
player_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18]
if player_nodes:
    p = player_nodes[0]
    b = p['boundary']
    player_top = b[0][0]
    print(f"Player top row: {player_top}")
    
# Check horizontal path position
path_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in ('w', 'g') and n['pixels'] <= 4 and n['boundary'][0][1] > 15]
path_rows = set()
for p in path_nodes:
    path_rows.add(p['boundary'][0][0])
print(f"Path rows: {sorted(path_rows)}")

# Blocks are at rows 13-16
# Current path is at rows 20-21
# Need to move UP by (20 - 14) / 2 = 3 more UP actions (each UP moves 2 rows)
# But let's try 2 UP actions first to see if it aligns

result = action(['UP', 'UP'])
print("\nAfter 2 UPs:")

# Check new positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18]
if player_nodes:
    p = player_nodes[0]
    b = p['boundary']
    print(f"Player top row: {b[0][0]}")

path_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in ('w', 'g') and n['pixels'] <= 4 and n['boundary'][0][1] > 15]
path_rows = set()
for p in path_nodes:
    path_rows.add(p['boundary'][0][0])
print(f"Path rows: {sorted(path_rows)}")

# Check if path is now at the same row as blocks
blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in ('N', 'b', 'R') and n['pixels'] == 16 and n['boundary'][0][0] < 50]
print(f"Block rows: {[b['boundary'][0][0] for b in blocks]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
